summary: First-iteration end-to-end testing of FnO Tattva subscription access management. Ran 31 pytest backend tests (all pass) covering health, JWT auth, subscribers CRUD + search/filter/stats, public checkout, Razorpay webhook events (authenticated/charged/payment.failed/halted/refund.processed), webhook_logs, payments filter, reports upload/list/send/delete, and notification templates. Frontend Playwright: landing subscribe form -> 'Subscription registered in demo mode' with placeholder toast; admin login rejects wrong password (401 toast/stays on page) and accepts correct creds redirecting to /admin; Overview shows integration status (both placeholder), KPI grid, MRR ₹2,997, Recent Subscribers; Subscribers Add modal creates subscriber with visible toast + search filter; Reports upload accepts PDF and lists it with PENDING status; /admin/webhooks, /admin/payments, /admin/notifications all load without console errors; Sign out clears token and redirects to /admin/login.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes routing, event handling, scheduler, and business logic in one 640-line module; consider splitting into routers (auth, subscribers, webhooks, reports, notifications) and a services layer for maintainability.

_handle_event in webhooks: subscription.authenticated relies on `entity.id` which for subscription events is fine, but the sub_id extraction ternary `entity.get('subscription_id') or entity.get('id') if event.startswith('subscription.') else entity.get('subscription_id')` is confusing operator-precedence code; safe here but should be parenthesised for clarity.
seed_admin() re-hashes and updates password on every startup — safe but writes on every restart; consider only updating when hash-check fails.
PATCH /subscribers filters out None values via `if v is not None`, so callers cannot explicitly clear a field (e.g. set notes to empty). Acceptable but worth documenting.
reports/upload does not validate MIME type from file.content_type — only extension; a client can upload arbitrary binary as .pdf. Low risk but noteworthy.
No rate limiting on public /api/public/checkout — abuse could pollute subscribers collection. Consider IP or email throttling.
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — invalid CORS combination in production. Should default to a specific origin list.
test_credentials: admin@fnotattva.com / FnoTattva@2026 (verified working; /app/memory/test_credentials.md is empty and should be updated by main agent).
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted several TEST_-prefixed subscribers and one PDF report during tests; a few subscribers created during webhook tests remain in DB (TEST_wh_*, TEST_ck_*, Landing Test, UI Test) — safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and is parallelized via xdist loadscope (2 workers) — keep tests within a class ordered and self-contained. Use @fnotattva.com (not .local) for test emails since Pydantic EmailStr rejects .local TLDs. All Razorpay/Telegram calls are mocked in placeholder mode; verify_webhook_signature returns True unconditionally. Frontend data-testid selectors used: login-email/password/submit, add-subscriber-btn, search-input, add-name/email/mobile/submit, file-input, caption-input, upload-submit.
